description: When a covered Vancouver house was built and what stood there: the building permit (1901–1930) and the City's year built, what the 1912 fire insurance map draws on the lot and whether today's building is very likely that one, what stands today, and who lived there in each directory year with each listing's source page, and where the 1921 census lists households at the address (Strathcona), their people, rent, rooms, origins and birthplaces as counts, never names. Residents' names through 1945 only; later years show a household and job without names. Anything inferred is marked inferred.

address.description: A Vancouver street address as written today or in the directories ("620 Keefer St", "2649 Yew"), an AddressLore house path ("620-keefer") or its URL.
